greeting.sub: Here's how your farm is doing today.

insight.title: AI insight of the day
tips: Check soil moisture in the early morning - readings are most reliable before the sun is high.
Split nitrogen into two or three doses across the season rather than one heavy application.
Keep a field logbook. Sowing dates and past yields make every recommendation sharper.
Irrigate at dawn or dusk to cut evaporation losses in warm weather.

heavyRain.title: Heavy rainfall expected
heavyRain.body: About {{rain}} mm of rain is likely over the next {{days}} days. Hold off on irrigation and check field drainage.

rain.title: Rain expected soon
rain.body: Rain is likely ({{chance}}% chance). Consider delaying irrigation and any fertilizer or spray application.

heat.title: High temperature expected
heat.body: Highs near {{temp}}°C in the coming days. Watch for crop water stress and irrigate in the early morning or evening.

dryAir.title: Low humidity
dryAir.body: Humidity around {{humidity}}%. Evaporation will be high - soil may dry out faster than usual.

wind.title: Strong wind expected
wind.body: Winds up to {{wind}} km/h. Avoid spraying and support young or tall crops.

cold.title: Cold conditions
cold.body: Lows near {{temp}}°C. Sensitive crops may need protection from cold or frost.

clear.title: Good conditions for field work
clear.body: Dry and settled weather over the next few days - a good window for sowing, spraying or harvest.

fertilizerReminder.title: Fertiliser window
fertilizerReminder.body: Your {{crop}} is at an early growth stage. Check whether a fertiliser split is due and confirm the dose with a local officer.

fieldData.title: Auto-fill from your location
fieldData.subtitle: Pull live weather and estimated soil values so you don't have to type them.
fieldData.soilNote: Soil values are area estimates from a global soil map. Use a local soil test for exact figures.
fieldData.unavailable: Could not fetch data for this location. You can enter the values manually.

predict.title: AI Crop Yield Prediction
predict.subtitle: Enter your farm details for a data-backed yield estimate. Optional soil and weather inputs refine it.
predict.optionalHint: All fields on this step are optional - fill what you know.
predict.envHint: Optional. Leave blank to use regional averages, or fill from the Weather page.

fields.farmSizeHint: Cultivated area for this crop, in hectares
fields.rainfallHint: Total rainfall over the year, in mm
fields.previousYieldHint: Your last yield for this crop, in t/ha (stored for your records)

form.failed: Could not get a prediction. Please try again.

result.qualityNote: This score reflects how consistent the model is for these inputs - it is not a probability. Verify with a local expert and a soil test.
result.adjustmentNote: Regional baseline {{core}} t/ha, adjusted x{{factor}} for your soil and weather inputs.
result.disclaimer: Estimate only. Yields vary with local soil, weather and management. Verify with a local agricultural expert and a current soil test before acting.

cropRec.title: Crop Recommendation
cropRec.subtitle: Enter your current soil test and typical season weather. The model ranks the crops best suited to those conditions.
cropRec.formHint: All seven values are required - use your latest soil report and seasonal averages.
cropRec.failed: Could not get recommendations. Please try again.
cropRec.disclaimer: Suitability is a model score from soil and weather only. It ignores market prices, seed availability and pests. Confirm with a local agricultural officer before sowing.

irrigation.title: Smart Irrigation
irrigation.subtitle: The model rates your field's irrigation need; a rule layer then estimates the water depth and schedule.
irrigation.formHint: Only crop is required. Fill soil moisture and weather for a sharper estimate.
irrigation.failed: Could not build an irrigation plan. Please try again.
irrigation.disclaimer: The need level is from a trained model; the depth and schedule are a rule of thumb. Check against your own field moisture readings and local advice before irrigating.

fertilizer.title: Fertilizer Recommendation
fertilizer.subtitle: Compares your soil N-P-K against the recommended dose for the crop and converts each gap into a common fertilizer.
fertilizer.failed: Could not build a fertilizer plan. Please try again.
fertilizer.disclaimer: Rule-based estimate from typical recommended doses. Dosage is not universally correct - get a local soil test and confirm with an agronomist before applying.

result.none: None - soil is at or above the recommended dose
